what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as manager.audit. Looked at Projects, the Kapoor Villa (Audit) page (Money chip shows read-only Contract value 25,00,000), Projects > Plan and budget (Budgets panel says 'No budgets set. Budgets are proposed as change requests.' but offers no budget form, only link/stage/baseline/move/template proposals), Money > Budgets and costs (budget table read-only), Money > Ledger and setup, the top + 'New' menu (Task, Site report, Site expense, Cost or purchase, Record payment, Project), Work, Settings and Inbox. Asked the Ask assistant twice in chat to raise the budget to 28,00,000 with a reason; first it only printed a budget summary, second it asked 'question or something to record?' and then said 'I can help create projects and tasks, record expenses or purchases, and answer budget and activity questions.' I never found any way to raise the budget. The budget still shows 25,00,000 everywhere. Nothing was submitted.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Project detail page Money chip (read-only figures)
Plan and budget tab (no budget input)
Money > Budgets and costs (clicked budget cell and row, nothing opened)
Work tab (empty, 'Ask the Admin to install a business pack')
unnecessary_steps: Had to re-pick Kapoor Villa in Plan and budget dropdown although the page already said 'Narrowed to Kapoor Villa (Audit)'
Chat asks 'question or something to record?' before answering
confusing_terminology: Approved budget / Contract value / Budget -> three names for what looks like the same number
Plan and budget -> sounds like where to edit budget but only has proposals for dependencies and stages
Narrowed to -> unclear jargon for project filter
Change request -> never explained, and no way to start a budget one
missing_feedback: Plan and budget says budgets are proposed as change requests but gives no button or form to do so
Clicking a budget row/cell gives no response
Dropdown option clicked with mouse did not select on first try (page stayed 'Choose a project')
Assistant did not say it cannot change budgets until the second reply
unexpected_behaviour: Selecting the project in the dropdown by mouse click did nothing; keyboard worked
Plan and budget ignores the already narrowed project
Inbox count rose from 9 to 11 with change request drafts I did not knowingly create
errors_encountered: I can help create projects and tasks, record expenses or purchases, and answer budget and activity questions.
visual_issues: Money view cards on Plan and budget overflow slightly past their container edge
Stage chip loses its pill background on row hover
Propose a change form is a dense unlabelled stack of fields and buttons
accessibility_issues: Mouse click on native dropdown option did not register; keyboard arrow+Enter was needed
Propose a change inputs rely on placeholders instead of visible labels
Small grey helper text with low contrast
observations: A manager cannot raise a project budget from any visible screen. Text hints that budgets go through change requests, but no entry point exists in the UI, the New menu, or the AI assistant. Overall the app is tidy and readable, but this task is a dead end.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: Visited about 10 screens; none offered a way to change a budget
rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: Task could not be completed at all
rating_justifications.ease_of_use: Plan and budget says budgets are proposed as change requests but shows no control for it
rating_justifications.clarity_of_terminology: Budget, Contract value and Approved budget used for the same figure; 'Narrowed to' and 'change request' unexplained
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Clicking budget rows did nothing; assistant first returned an unrelated summary
rating_justifications.error_recovery: Assistant reply only listed what it can do, with no pointer to where budgets can be changed
